item.title: [7.1] The Illusion of Cross-Lingual Safety in Low-Resource Languages
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Safety alignment in large language models (LLMs) is largely developed in English, assuming these safeguards generalize across multilingual settings. However, this assumption remains underexplored and exposes a vulnerability in low-resource languages. We investigate cross-lingual safety transfer in four African languages, Twi, Hausa, Amharic, and Swahili, using LoDNA, a new safety dataset that...

WHY IT MATTERS

This research uncovers a critical security vulnerability in LLM safety alignment, demonstrating that English-centric safeguards fail catastrophically in low-resource African languages.
